name: gaongreen-website
description: GaonGreen static site. package.json exists only to pin and vendor third-party browser code reproducibly.

gaongreen.note: 2.118.0 is the CANDIDATE reviewed earlier. Before adopting, run `npm view @supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0 deprecated` (empty = not deprecated) and choose the newest stable version that satisfies your minimum-age rule. Then change this exact version, regenerate package-lock.json and re-run tools/vendor-supabase.sh.
gaongreen.scripts_note: test:offline and test:rls-offline use only loopback mocks. test:rls-staging is the MANUAL real-staging run: it refuses unless ALLOW_STAGING=yes and a non-production https URL are given (see docs/RLS_STAGING_RUNBOOK.md).

scripts.test:rls-offline: node tests/rls-harness.js rls-harness.json && node tests/rls-guards.js rls-guards.json
